title: Circuit size language
statement: The size language of a circuit family consists of the strings that encode a pair whose first component is a unary string of $n$ true symbols and whose second component is the binary representation of a natural number $i$, for some $n$ and $i$, with $i$ strictly less than the size of the family’s circuit at parameter $n$.
hypotheses_covered: The string is the specified pair encoding
$i$ is strictly less than the circuit size at $n$
